question: Should OpenClaw now make imsg 0.11.1 the mandatory iMessage startup floor and remove the client-side split-send fallback for all users?
rationale: This intentionally converts an existing compatible setup into a fail-closed upgrade requirement; upstream capability is available, but the linked issue still carries a product-decision signal and no maintainer has confirmed the floor in the supplied discussion.

options.title: Adopt the 0.11.1 floor
options.body: Accept the external CLI upgrade requirement after the validation shim is removed and live fresh-install plus upgrade proof is supplied.

options.title: Retain the fallback temporarily
options.body: Keep the current coalescing path until maintainers are ready to make the imsg upgrade mandatory for existing iMessage installations.

recommendation.title: Adopt the 0.11.1 floor
recommendation.body: Accept the external CLI upgrade requirement after the validation shim is removed and live fresh-install plus upgrade proof is supplied.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history connects this person to the current iMessage monitor surface and adjacent imsg release ownership, making them the strongest routing candidate for the dependency-floor decision.
